scene.method: Viser client render; full fixed scan, recorded simulator joint excerpt looped twice, camera lens outlines; no live feed or physics during rendering

simulator_rgb.sampling: First exposure in each 1/6-second bin, original capture/send order, state sampled at 20 Hz
simulator_rgb.jpeg_changes: RGB decode and JPEG quality-90 re-encode; metadata removed; not bit-identical source JPEGs
simulator_rgb.geometry: Fitted primitives and scan-derived tabletop texture, not full Gaussian camera rendering
simulator_rgb.source_kind: Scripted historical SAPIEN episode; no physical robot

phone.scope: Owner approved original seconds 18.4-26.4, its silent comparison and GIF after private preview; full original excluded.
phone.demonstration: Approved recorded RGB synchronized with checkerboard-derived camera position, orientation, frustum and valid history in the fixed kitchen scan.
phone.pose_source: Recomputed from the bundled silent public excerpt using the original detector/PnP; known measured board placement and historical video-fitted intrinsics scaled to 960x540.
phone.invalid_policy: Hide current frustum. Retain valid history without connecting across gaps. No interpolation.
phone.geometry_scope: Image-derived pose diagnostic; no independent world-accuracy validation, real depth fusion or hardware-latency measurement.
phone.renderer: 48 actual Viser client renders, paired with undistorted phone RGB; fixed viewport crop for legibility.
phone.selection: Selected for continuous checkerboard tracking, not a full-recording success rate. Replaces the earlier 6-18-second presentation excerpt.
